items.title: Jensen Huang’s Return Shows Nvidia Is Too Big to Police
items.summary: Nvidia’s place at the center of the US economy may have outweighed concerns about its CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, national security and foreign policy experts say.
items.author: Dell Cameron

items.title: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees in First All-Hands Since His Return
items.summary: The Nvidia CEO opened up about his personal life, defended his reinstatement, and acknowledged that his intense management style had hurt his staff.
items.author: Paresh Dave

items.title: Anthropic Created a Honeypot to Lure AI Agents Into Misbehaving
items.summary: A new test assumes AI agents can go rogue—and asks whether they can resist temptation.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: Don’t Bring Up AI if You Want to Enjoy Your Thanksgiving
items.summary: Young people anxious about their futures say they’re increasingly frustrated with their pro-AI parents. They’re worried it’s going to make holiday gatherings very tense.
items.author: Elana Klein

items.title: AI Solved Math’s Most Famous Problem. Now Humans Are Struggling to Understand It
items.summary: It will take mathematicians months to understand the “alien” 17-million-line solution an Anthropic researcher produced for the Riemann hypothesis.
items.author: Isabella Ward
